description: Designs structured, multi-round interview processes: maps each role competency to an interview stage, sizes and staffs the panel, orders the stages, writes behaviorally anchored scorecards, sets STAR+ criteria for judging answers, and lays out an evidence-based debrief and candidate comparison. Use when someone asks for an interview plan, interview loop, scorecard or rubric, panel setup, debrief process, or wants to make hiring more consistent and defensible. Supports human interviewers only and never scores or ranks candidates.
